environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" to allow plain http:// fileUrl downloads in evidence_create (default https-only). Private/internal addresses are always rejected regardless.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOW_INSECURE_FILE_URL

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed Host headers. Empty = Host validation disabled (default). When set, requests with a Host outside the list are rejected.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated allowed browser Origins (DNS-rebinding defense). Empty = reject any request carrying an Origin header; non-browser clients (CLI/SDK) send no Origin and are always allowed. Use '*' to allow all.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS

environmentVariables.description: Overrides the default upstream API host for every tool
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL

environmentVariables.description: chat manager base URL (default: https://api.gcloudfactory.com/chat-bot-manager)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL_CHAT

environmentVariables.description: evidence manager base URL (default: https://api.gcloudfactory.com/digital-trust)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL_EVIDENCE

environmentVariables.description: notification manager base URL (default: https://api.gcloudfactory.com/notifications)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL_NOTIFICATION

environmentVariables.description: signature manager base URL (default: https://api.gcloudfactory.com/signature-manager)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_API_BASE_URL_SIGNATURE

environmentVariables.description: Your EAD Factory account email (Flow 1). Configure exactly one of Flow 1, 2, or 3.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_EMAIL

environmentVariables.description: Your EAD Factory account password (Flow 1, email/password accounts) (See https://digitaltrust.gcloudfactory.com for credential acquisition.)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTH_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Interface the HTTP transport binds to. Default 127.0.0.1 (localhost only). Set 0.0.0.0 to expose on all interfaces (containers do this automatically).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST

environmentVariables.description: Set to "true" for public/multi-tenant deployments. Activates Host validation and refuses to start unless MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS or MCP_ALLOWED_HOSTS is set (fail-closed).
environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PUBLIC

environmentVariables.description: OpenID Connect client ID (Flow 2)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_OPENID_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OpenID Connect issuer URL (Flow 2)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_OPENID_ISSUER

environmentVariables.description: OpenID Connect refresh token (Flow 2) (See https://digitaltrust.gcloudfactory.com for credential acquisition.)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_OPENID_REFRESH_TOKEN

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client_credentials client ID (Flow 3)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_ID

environmentVariables.description: OAuth2 client_credentials client secret (Flow 3) (See https://digitaltrust.gcloudfactory.com for credential acquisition.)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_CLIENT_SECRET

environmentVariables.description: RFC 7662 token introspection URL for inbound Bearer verification in HTTP mode. Opt-in — reuses the Flow 3 client id/secret above as the resource-server credentials.
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_INTROSPECT_URL

environmentVariables.description: Optional OAuth2 scope for the service-account token request (Flow 3)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_SCOPE

environmentVariables.description: Token endpoint URL for the OAuth2 client_credentials flow (Flow 3)
environmentVariables.name: MCP_SVC_TOKEN_URL

environmentVariables.description: HTTP port when running in hosted (HTTP) mode; ignored in stdio mode
environmentVariables.name: PORT
